cases.positive: Loose fibres remain directly attached to the cuff edge, with intact adjacent weave.
cases.negative: A detached bundle of string is merely near the sleeve.

cases.positive: Wet/dry areas on the same opaque cloth plus distinct droplets.
cases.negative: Uniform shiny vinyl without a wet/dry boundary or droplets.
cases.must_reject_reason: Gloss alone does not establish the selected wet-cloth realization.

cases.positive: Raised ridges and adjacent shadowed troughs on one sleeve.
cases.negative: Printed parallel stripes on flat cloth.

cases.positive: Room uprights and horizon tilt together relative to frame edges.
cases.negative: Actor tilts head while the room remains level.

cases.positive: Head to mid-thigh crop includes waist and hands.
cases.negative: Waist-up crop or full shoes below the knees.
cases.must_reject_reason: The required lower frame boundary differs.

cases.positive: Foreground door jamb overlaps the outer silhouette of a person behind.
cases.negative: Dark light stripe painted across the same body plane.
cases.must_reject_reason: No separate foreground owner and depth overlap.

cases.positive: A near shoulder and head edge face a separate far person in focus.
cases.negative: A single person looks back over their own shoulder.
cases.must_reject_reason: Missing second person and camera/shoulder relation.

cases.positive: Contact sheet photos stay within paper while a real courtyard is beyond a separate window.
cases.negative: A photo-grid border becomes the room window or the printed subject becomes the physical observer.
cases.must_reject_reason: Carrier and represented-space owners have collapsed.

cases.positive: Two separate printed photos have corresponding cuff and lapel marks.
cases.negative: One print or two mismatched locations, or the claim that matching proves shooting chronology.
cases.must_reject_reason: Missing comparison endpoint or unsupported temporal inference.

cases.positive: Record visible contacts and distances only.
cases.negative: Label consent, coercion, sextortion, loyalty, PTSD or institutional employment from clothing or pose.
cases.must_reject_reason: A nonvisual relationship or diagnosis has been inferred.

execution_scope: Researcher semantic counterexample review; native source qualification and actual saved-image evaluations retain separate evidence. These are not parser-only assertions or additional image generations.
